# @code4lala/dsh-plugin-workspace-path

A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) client
plugin that displays the **full directory path** below each workspac

e title in
the web sidebar, with line wrapping.
侧边栏的每个工作区标题下方显示完整的目录路径，自动换行。
📦 npm 包主页 / npm package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/@code4lala/dsh-plugin-workspace-path>

ates on the next `dsh web` boot. To activate it in an

end to
`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The running dsh web server watches this file and hot-loads the plugin.
## How it works

- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`): no behavior — everything happens in the browser.
- **Client half**

(`lib/client.js`): reads the workspace list from the
`workspaces` client service and injects a `wkp

ath-subtitle` element with
each workspace's path below its sidebar title, kept in sync through a
`Mu

tationObserver` plus a subscription to the workspace list. Rows are
matched to workspaces **position

ally** (sidebar order equals the workspace
list's stable order), so workspaces with identical titles

each show their
own path — never a collision.

atched by position). Subtitles also
